limitations: Synthetic scan reports; this benchmark does not measure scanner detection.
Local single-host closed-loop measurements are not production load capacity or a Base Sepolia SLO.
API and RPC outages are explicitly injected; separate transport tests cover slow/stalled networks.
No proactive notification latency claim: revocation is measured at the next admission check.
p99 from small samples is a smoke measurement; use larger repeated trials for capacity planning.
